## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复配置网络代理的 ChatGPT 账号无法创建或修复为原生登录实例的问题。原生桌面和 CLI 实例支持 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS5、SOCKS5H 及代理认证，保留客户端的 ChatGPT 身份。
- 修复显式直连被误判为不支持的代理；实例直连设置覆盖继承及系统代理。已有实例保留接入方式，可停止后使用「修复为原生账号登录」。
- 实例专属转接服务随后台管理器保留到实例退出；启动取消、停止和异常退出会回收服务。转接服务退出时提示连接中断；请求失败不自动直连。代理密码不进入客户端启动参数。

- Fixed native sign-in being blocked for ChatGPT accounts with an upstream proxy. Managed desktop and CLI instances support authenticated HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 and SOCKS5H while retaining their ChatGPT identity.
- Fixed explicit direct routing being rejected; it now overrides inherited and system proxies. Existing instance modes are preserved and can be repaired to native sign-in after stopping.
- Each instance keeps its proxy relay while the manager runs in the background. Cancellation, stop and exit reclaim the relay. Relay exit reports a disconnected instance; failed requests never fall back to direct, and proxy passwords stay out of client arguments.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）DMG / ZIP，附件含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。保留账号、实例、会话和本地配置；请在方便停止实例时退出旧管理器并打开新版。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. Quit the old manager and open the new version when it is convenient to stop your instances. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。代理支持适用于管理器启动的实例；外部浏览器和自行启动的客户端使用自身网络配置。原生账号功能仍取决于套餐、工作区与客户端版本。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop 尚未接入。

Codex is supported and must be installed separately. Proxy routing applies to instances launched by the manager; external browsers and independently launched clients use their own network settings. Native account features depend on the plan, workspace and client version. Claude Code and Claude Desktop are not yet integrated.

## 验证来源 / Verification

版本标签 `v0.4.11` 指向完整来源提交；本 Release 对应的 GitHub Actions “Build release” 运行记录提供源码与打包检查结果。安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

The `v0.4.11` tag identifies the full source commit. Its GitHub Actions “Build release” run records source and packaged-application checks. Installer hashes are provided in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
